description: Read the AWS documentation for VPC Peering Connections https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonVPC/latest/UserGuide/vpc-peering.html.

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: peer_owner_id
parameters.description: The AWS account number for cross account peering.

parameters.name: peer_vpc_id
parameters.description: VPC id of the accepting VPC.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: purge_tags
parameters.description: If purge_tags=true and tags is set, existing tags will be purged from the resource to match exactly what is defined by tags parameter. If the tags parameter is not set then tags will not be modified, even if purge_tags=True. Tag keys beginning with aws: are reserved by Amazon and can not be modified. As such they will be ignored for the purposes of the purge_tags parameter. See the Amazon documentation for more information https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws_tagging.html#tag-conventions. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create, delete, accept, reject a peering connection. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "accept" "reject"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A dictionary representing the tags to be applied to the resource. If the tags parameter is not set then tags will not be modified.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: vpc_id
parameters.description: VPC id of the requesting VPC.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Wait for peering state changes to complete. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
# Complete example to create and accept a local peering connection.
- name: Create local account EC2 VPC Peering Connection
  amazon.aws.ec2_vpc_peering:
    region: "ap-southeast-2"
    vpc_id: "vpc-12345678"
    peer_vpc_id: "vpc-87654321"
    state: "present"
    tags:
      Name: "Peering connection for VPC 21 to VPC 22"
      CostCode: "CC1234"
      Project: "phoenix"
  register: vpc_peer

- name: Accept local EC2 VPC Peering request
  amazon.aws.ec2_vpc_peering:
    region: "ap-southeast-2"
    peering_id: "{{ vpc_peer.peering_id }}"
    state: "accept"
  register: action_peer

# Complete example to delete a local peering connection.
- name: Create local account EC2 VPC Peering Connection
  amazon.aws.ec2_vpc_peering:
    region: "ap-southeast-2"
    vpc_id: "vpc-12345678"
    peer_vpc_id: "vpc-87654321"
    state: "present"

  register: vpc_peer

- name: Delete a local EC2 VPC Peering Connection
  amazon.aws.ec2_vpc_peering:
    region: "ap-southeast-2"
    peering_id: "{{ vpc_peer.peering_id }}"
    state: "absent"
  register: vpc_peer

  # Complete example to create and accept a cross account peering connection.
- name: Create cross account EC2 VPC Peering Connection
  amazon.aws.ec2_vpc_peering:
    region: "ap-southeast-2"
    vpc_id: "vpc-12345678"
    peer_vpc_id: "vpc-12345678"
    peer_owner_id: "123456789012"
    state: "present"

      Name: "Peering connection for VPC 21 to VPC 22"
      CostCode: "CC1234"
      Project: "phoenix"
  register: vpc_peer

- name: Accept EC2 VPC Peering Connection from remote account
  amazon.aws.ec2_vpc_peering:
    region: "ap-southeast-2"
    peering_id: "{{ vpc_peer.peering_id }}"
    profile: "bot03_profile_for_cross_account"

# Complete example to create and accept an intra-region peering connection.
- name: Create intra-region EC2 VPC Peering Connection

    region: "us-east-1"
    vpc_id: "vpc-12345678"

    state: "present"
    tags:
      Name: "Peering connection for us-east-1 VPC to us-west-2 VPC"
      CostCode: "CC1234"
      Project: "phoenix"
  register: vpc_peer

- name: Accept EC2 VPC Peering Connection from peer region
  amazon.aws.ec2_vpc_peer:
    region: "us-west-2"
    peering_id: "{{ vpc_peer.peering_id }}"
    state: "accept"
  register: vpc_peer

# Complete example to create and reject a local peering connection.

# Complete example to create and reject a cross account peering connection.

return_values.name: peering_id
return_values.description: The id of the VPC peering connection created/deleted. Returned: always Sample: "pcx-034223d7c0aec3cde"

return_values.name: vpc_peering_connection
return_values.description: The details of the VPC peering connection. Returned: success

return_values.name: accepter_vpc_info
return_values.description: Information about the VPC which accepted the connection. Returned: success

return_values.name: cidr_block
return_values.description: The primary CIDR for the VPC. Returned: when connection is in the accepted state. Sample: "10.10.10.0/23"

return_values.name: cidr_block_set
return_values.description: A list of all CIDRs for the VPC. Returned: when connection is in the accepted state.

return_values.name: owner_id
return_values.description: The AWS account that owns the VPC. Returned: success Sample: "123456789012"

return_values.name: peering_options
return_values.description: Additional peering configuration. Returned: when connection is in the accepted state.

return_values.name: allow_dns_resolution_from_remote_vpc
return_values.description: Indicates whether a VPC can resolve public DNS hostnames to private IP addresses when queried from instances in a peer VPC. Returned: success

return_values.name: allow_egress_from_local_classic_link_to_remote_vpc
return_values.description: Indicates whether a local ClassicLink connection can communicate with the peer VPC over the VPC peering connection. Returned: success

return_values.name: allow_egress_from_local_vpc_to_remote_classic_link
return_values.description: Indicates whether a local VPC can communicate with a ClassicLink connection in the peer VPC over the VPC peering connection. Returned: success

return_values.name: region
return_values.description: The AWS region that the VPC is in. Returned: success Sample: "us-east-1"

return_values.name: vpc_id
return_values.description: The ID of the VPC Returned: success Sample: "vpc-0123456789abcdef0"

return_values.name: expiration_time
return_values.description: The time that an unaccepted VPC peering connection will expire. Returned: success Sample: "2024-10-01T12:11:12+00:00"

return_values.name: requester_vpc_info
return_values.description: Information about the VPC which requested the connection. Returned: success

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: Details of the current status of the connection. Returned: success

return_values.name: code
return_values.description: A short code describing the status of the connection. Returned: success Sample: "active"

return_values.name: message
return_values.description: Additional information about the status of the connection. Returned: success Sample: "Pending Acceptance by 123456789012"

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: Tags applied to the connection. Returned: success

return_values.name: vpc_peering_connection_id
return_values.description: The ID of the VPC peering connection. Returned: success Sample: "pcx-0123456789abcdef0"
